title: EC2 Networking & Placement
summary: How EC2 instances are addressed and placed: private vs public IPv4, why public IPs change, when an Elastic IP is (and is not) the right fix, the cluster, spread and partition placement strategies, elastic network interfaces for failover, and EC2 Hibernate for keeping RAM state across a stop.
